en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with multi‑story buildings, with pedestrians and a few horse‑drawn carts. The view looks down the street toward a small church or public building in the distance. There is handwritten correspondence in purple ink along the top and right margins. Printed text at the bottom reads "ARGOSTOLI. - Lithostroto." and a small printer's credit appears at the lower left.
